defects.justification: flask>=3.0 is an open lower bound with no upper pin or lock file.
pytest>=8.0 is an open lower bound with no upper pin or lock file.
POST /imports (and GET /imports/<id>) have no authentication, so anyone who can reach the service can overwrite customer records by email through an upload.
Each upload starts a new thread with no pool or limit, each holding up to 10 MB of decoded text plus the parsed row list in memory, so a burst of uploads exhausts threads and memory.
The SELECT existence check and the upsert are separate statements outside a transaction, so concurrent imports touching the same email miscount inserted vs updated rows (README admits this).
